name: disktop
description: See what fills your Linux disks and reclaim space safely: a terminal dashboard and scriptable CLI whose cleanup is reviewed, journaled, Trash-first, and undoable

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/set-executable.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/contract/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run build:native && node --test tests/integration/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:recovery: npm run build && npm run build:native && node --test tests/recovery/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:performance: npm run build && npm run build:native && node --test tests/performance/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:recovery && npm run test:pty
scripts.bench: npm run build && cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path native/disktop-fs/Cargo.toml && DISKTOP_REQUIRE_RELEASE_BENCHMARK=1 DISKTOP_BENCH_ENTRIES=1000000 node --test tests/performance/*.test.mjs
